content.short: DeltaPrime is an undercollateralized borrowing and investing protocol on Avalanche and Arbitrum.
content.description: DeltaPrime is a decentralized prime brokerage protocol that enables undercollateralized borrowing and lending on the Avalanche and Arbitrum networks. Through its unique "Prime Account" structure, users can borrow up to 5x their collateral to invest in a curated list of integrated DeFi protocols, maximizing capital efficiency while maintaining a secure and automated liquidation framework. The protocol is designed to bridge the gap between traditional prime brokerage and decentralized finance, providing professional-grade leverage tools for sophisticated investors. By fostering deep integrations with other DeFi protocols, DeltaPrime serves as a powerful multiplier for liquidity and yield across the ecosystem.
